---
description: Analyze de-identified R&D images and metrics without clinical interpretation.
---
Use only synthetic or de-identified R&D data. Compare background, illumination, torch, phone model, focus, glare, geometry score, aspect ratio, stretch ratio and A/B/C quality. For uZinc, analyze repeatability, pixel heterogeneity, P1/P2/P3, center/periphery, Lab, hue, chroma, deltaE and normalized RGB. Do not choose a clinical cut-off or produce a diagnostic result.
